paragraphs: (Karmi son of Zavdi, Joshua, beginning of chapter 7.) Rabbi Abba bar Zavda: Berakhot 11a; in Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6, Rabbah bar Zavda, where Hyman interprets “Rabbah” as a compression of Rabbi Ba. Oshaya bar Zavda: Taanit 26b. Rabbi Bizna bar Zavda: Berakhot 55b. Rabbi Yehudah bar Zavda (or Zevida): Berakhot 12b. Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi: Kiddushin 33b. Rav Nachman bar Zavda: Shabbat 25b.

notes.text: Hyman’s abbreviation claim concerns רבה alone as a compression of Rabbi Ba, not the entire patronymic. The Yevamot 1:6 reference is Jerusalem Talmud.
